profile.headline: Senior Software Developer, WB Games NY

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead developer on the Hydra Studio game services platform.

company.name: Warner Bros. Entertainment Group of Companies

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
I was a lead engineer on new features, data integrity, and performance optimization for the internal Bluebird constituent management system (CRM), the Open Legislation information system, and the Senate Address Geo-coding Engine. I worked extensively on all major functionality for all systems described below.

Bluebird CRM, based on the CiviCRM, is used daily by senate offices to conduct mass mailings (both paper and email), track on going cases, and keep a records of constituent engagement and legislative positions. Bluebird is written in PHP and MySQL (stored procedures, triggers, mods, etc). Data in this system is routinely merged with voter registration data to keep constituencies and mailing addresses up to date. As part of my daily work I interacted directly with the CiviCRM core development team and was able to push dozens of changes upstream.

Open Legislation is a website with a full API that allows constituents and other developers to access structured data and form complex queries on all data relevant to the legislation process. Open Legislation is written in Java on the Servlets platform with Lucene as the primary data store. Open Legislation processes change logs of Calendar, Active List, Bill, Resolution, Meeting, and Vote data from the Senate's internal bill drafting system into Lucene for fast, flexible queries. Open Legislation directly supports the NYSenate.gov and Bluebird CRM systems as well as the Sunlight Foundation's Open States project.

SAGE is a website with a full API that uses Census Tiger/Line files and NY State shape files to map addresses to specific counties, towns, school districts, etc. SAGE is written in Java on the Servlets platform with a PostgreSQL GIS backend. It is used for asynchronous bulk processing of millions of voter records as part of Bluebird's ongoing data maintenance and as a single record lookup for validating and processing addresses manually entered into the Senate's NYSenate.gov website and Bluebird CRM.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
ggtracker.com is a website that provides data visualization and actionable performance benchmarks for  players that upload their Starcraft II replays. I was the primary developer for the python tools used to extract and process data from the replays into the structured records used by the website. Processing had 3 primary steps:

* Extracting raw event data from a structured bitstream.
* Running that event data through a partial game engine to recreate state.
* Analyzing that state frame by frame to detect important game events and trends.

This work was done in Python.

positions.title: Researcher/Software Developer
positions.description: Developing open source software and open standards in conjunction with the New York State Senate CIO's office to support open government and legislative transparency.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant and Tutor
positions.description:
I assist my students in learning the material in the Computer Science I and II courses during their lab sessions.  These sessions are two hours long and task the student with programming a solution to a given problem.  I help them to understand the problem, logically construct a solution, and implement it in C++.

Additionally through the Advising, Learning and Assistance Center (ALAC) and privately, I tutored individuals on 1000 and 2000 level computer science courses.

positions.title: Open Legislation Developer
positions.description: Worked in the CIO's office, primarily on the Open Legislation software. Reworked the architecture, redesigned/implemented the new 2.0 API, developed user and developer documentation, and spoke at the 2nd annual Capitol Camp unconference.

positions.title: Package Handler
positions.description: Responsibilities included screening the packages, loading up the trucks and training new hires.
